claim_scope: Machine-readable leaf/gate ledger consumed by tools/publish_coverage.py (SXT-029, issue #22). It records, per landed leaf, the verification verdicts of the committed evidence records (full sha256 pins; the tool re-hashes at run time and marks STALE on mismatch), and per unlanded leaf the filed issue (or backlog id) that must land first. Verification statuses use the PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED/NO_VERDICT/STALE vocabulary. Nothing here is a support, fidelity, quality, or hardware claim; essentiality is UNVERIFIED pending listening (#8/#9). A leaf is support-ready only when rtl_vs_model AND model_vs_reference are both PASS AND the fidelity_freeze gate is PASS (issue #12).
